The check now also refuses any escaped identifier after the marker and applies holon.lean.FORBIDDEN to this contract's own comment-free reading. Build review M2: rule T7's text checks could be bypassed in Bend. They strip `#...` comments line by line without regard to string literals, so a record pattern after a "#" string in a one-line match was invisible, and a helper opening the record proved per-edge facts by computation while dead `_a = avail_0(h)` lines satisfied the naming check (the reviewer's demo passed bend, --verdict and this test). The check now refuses string and char literals in an instance PROOF.bend (so `#` always starts a comment) and requires each bridge_* body to be exactly `match h:`, one record case, `{==}`. Stricter only: the committed proofs have no literal and their bridges have that form.

Build review M2 (the same hole as rule T7's): the canary PROOF.bend's record checks read lines with `#...` removed regardless of strings; the check now refuses string and char literals there too, so `#` always starts a comment. Stricter only: the committed canary proofs have none.
